title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.page.create tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #5, §1.2). page.create is MUTATING (class M; proxied-to-REST POST elementor-ultra/v1/documents) — it CREATES its own blank draft, so it does not touch the shared disposable draft and needs no token substitution; status:'draft' keeps it unpublished. The driver TRASHES the created draft in teardown (it tracks ids returned by create-class smokes) so the live site is left clean. MINIMAL valid input per §1.2: every field is optional/defaulted ({title?, post_type?='page', template?, status?='draft'}); we set `title` + explicit status:'draft'. The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {id, edit_url, status, type}.
